{{Quote|On Yavin 4, R2-BHD usually flew with Jon Vander, the leader of Gold Squadron's Y-wings.|The ''[[Galactic Explorer's Guide]]''|<ref name="Galactic Explorer's Guide">''[[Star Wars: The Galactic Explorer's Guide]]''</ref>}}
'''R2-BHD''', also known as '''Tooby''', was an [[R2-series astromech droid]] who served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. By the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]], the [[droid]] worked with the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet's]] [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]], and most commonly flew with the [[squadron]]'s [[Gold Leader|leader]] [[Jon Vander]]. It was present in the Alliance's [[Great Temple|headquarters]] on the [[moon]] [[Yavin 4]] shortly before Gold Squadron participated in the [[Battle of Scarif]].

==Biography==
[[File:R2-BHD_rouse.png|thumb|left|200px|R2-BHD with access panels open]]
R2-BHD was an [[R2-series astromech droid|R2-series]] [[astromech droid]] that served the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Imperial Era|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" /> By the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Galactic Atlas">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas: Updated Edition]]''</ref> the [[droid]] had served the Alliance for years and was assigned to the [[Rebel Alliance Navy|Alliance Fleet's]] [[Gold Squadron (Rebel Alliance)|Gold Squadron]], and rotated through the [[squadron]]'s [[pilot]]s, mostly commonly being assigned to [[Gold Leader]] [[Jon Vander]] and his [[BTL Y-wing starfighter|Y-wing starfighter]] ''[[Gold One]]''.<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" /> R2-BHD also was responsible for performing diagnostics to keep the squadron's Y-wing [[starfighter]]s ready for battle.<ref name="Databank">{{Databank|r2-bhd-tooby|R2-BHD (Tooby)}}</ref>

R2-BHD was present in a hangar in the [[Great Temple]] on Yavin 4 when the [[Rebel Alliance Intelligence Service]] officer [[Cassian Jeron Andor]] led the newly recruited [[Jyn Erso]] through it en route<ref name="Rogue One" /> to a [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft]]<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" /> outside the temple that the pair would fly to the [[planet]] [[Jedha]]. Shortly afterwards, Gold Squadron took part in a [[Battle of Scarif|battle]] against the Empire above the [[planet]] [[Scarif]].<ref name="Rogue One" /> R2-BHD later flew with Vander against the Empire at the [[Battle of Yavin]], where they were shot down by [[Anakin Skywalker|Darth Vader]].<ref name="ANH">{{Film|IV}}</ref>

[[Standard decade|Decade]]s later, R2-BHD was mentioned in the ''[[Galactic Explorer's Guide]]'', a survival guide written by [[Hondo Ohnaka]] and [[DK-RA-43]].<ref name="Galactic Explorer's Guide" />

==Characteristics==
R2-BHD was a loyal and attentive droid and found the grouchy personality of other droids like [[D4-R4B]] illogical. It had silver colored plates<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" /> with yellow accents<ref name="Databank" /> that were unadorned, that made it look unfinished.<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" /> It had black [[sensor]]s.<ref name="Rogue One" /> Like all [[R-series]] astromechs it was manufactured by [[Industrial Automaton]],<ref name="USW">''[[Ultimate Star Wars, New Edition]]''</ref> and stood 1.09 [[meter]]s tall.<ref name="Databank" /> R2-BHD sported cranial access ports that could be opened up when in repair configuration. It also had an electro-port access tool equipped behind a panel on its front.<ref name="Rogue One Visual Guide" />

==Behind the scenes==
R2-BHD was created for the [[Star Wars Anthology Series|stand-alone film]] ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'',<ref name="Rogue One" /> which was released on [[December 16]], [[2016]].<ref name="RO release">{{SW|url=news/rogue-one-details-revealed-at-star-wars-celebration-anaheim|text=''Rogue One'' Details Revealed at ''Star Wars'' Celebration Anaheim}}</ref> The character was revealed prior to the film in the form of a figure released by [[The Walt Disney Company|Disney]] in [[2015]] as part of a set with three other astromechs from ''Rogue One'' as part of the [[Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|''Star Wars: Droid Factory'']] toy line.<ref name="Toy">{{DisneyToyCite|set=Star Wars: Droid Factory (toy line)|packtype=Multipack|pack=C2-B5 · R2-BHD · R3-M2 · R5-SK1|altlink=https://www.jeditemplearchives.com/content/modules.php?name=JReviews&rop=showcontent&id=2692}}</ref> It was unknown at the time of the film's release if he participated in the [[Battle of Yavin]]. It was later confirmed thanks to a [[LEGO]] set released in [[2023]].<ref name="LEGO">{{LEGOCite|num=75365|name=Yavin 4 Rebel Base}}</ref>
